# ScribeCat 0.25.2

## Fixed
- Restore PDF text selection in the embedded viewer, including when zoom controls are used.
- Reset PDF zoom to 100% by clicking the zoom button while zoomed.
- Automatically open the zoom slider when pinch/trackpad zoom starts.
- Keep pinch and trackpad zoom anchored to the pointer position.
- Restore desktop mouse drag panning while zoomed, with grab/grabbing cursors.
- Add a live PDF minimap showing the current viewport.
- Keep inline Word, PowerPoint and video viewers working with paste, drag-and-drop and the image toolbar picker.
- Add touch-swipe and keyboard navigation for PowerPoint single-slide preview.

## Release
- Version manifests are bumped to 0.25.2.
